description: Target-route bus watcher for blind and low-vision wearers: register the one route you want, then the agent only speaks for that route. Point your head at an approaching bus and tap CHECK: a telephoto photo plus the host language model reads the bus head sign, compares it with your target, and speaks only the verdict — this is your bus, or this is route X, not yours, keep waiting. It never gives a generic scene description, never listens to announcements, and its look-out reminders run only while the page is open.
name: my-bus-watch
